title: 15 "Ugly" Businesses Nobody Wants (That Print Cash)
description:
Septic pumping, dumpster rental, grease traps, biohazard cleanup. Here are 15 ugly businesses nobody wants, why the weak competition makes them profitable, and how to start one without betting everything.
